purpose: Code verification and prospective deterministic qualification-policy evaluation, not physical validation or production training data

order_verification.interpretation: observed smooth-solution order, not proof for corner-singular legacy model

policies.residual_only: Return first mesh with discrete PASS
policies.current_mesh: Return first successive pair whose mid-plane current difference / max(abs(fine current),1e-15) <= 0.01 and both solves PASS
policies.field_controller: Require two consecutive passing refinement pairs. At each pair interpolate fine psi and log concentrations to coarse centres; max absolute psi difference and max relative concentration differences and mid-current difference are multiplied by safety/(2^p-1), with p=2 and safety=2. Compare to the same observable budgets. Emit fine mesh as ESTIMATED_ACCEPT, never certified error bound.
policies.uniform_finest: Attempt 96x48 directly; discrete PASS gives baseline accepted output, independently evaluated afterwards

cost_estimand: Single execution of each grid cached across policy replay; sum construction-plus-solve observed costs for all meshes a policy would require, including failed attempts. Selection/check overhead reported separately. These are deterministic retrospective replays of frozen prospective rules, not separate randomized wall-clock trials.
evaluation_separation: Exact fields/analytic current used only after policy decisions to score actual error; controller receives numerical arrays/current/status only
failure_handling: Preserve failed solves; no fallback to exact initialization. Budget exhaustion yields UNRESOLVED; manufactured cases never become physical training targets.
scope_limits: Eight fixed holdout scenarios are not random population sampling
No proof of reliable error bounds
